'''catman421 Jabba's Palace Representatives (MKOS) (V1)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[catman421]]
* '''Published:''' 27 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|JPSD-D-mykindofscum.gif|label=My Kind Of Scum}}
* '''Strategy:''' My Kind Of Scum
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 MKOS catman421 DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

A fast and fun deck.  Very powerful characters for cheap.  Designed for Tatooine only play.

The published list has 57 cards.

== Strategy ==

get Pote and Scum and villany out along with Jabba to get Skillrings that are power 4 and forfeit around 7 or 8.
